purpose: Diagnose, without retuning, why the frozen binary coverage QUBO objective increases with receptor count while BACE1 BEDROC20 declines.

diagnostic_gate.rank_misalignment_rule: Declare the binary top-10-percent objective misaligned if its pooled Spearman correlation with robust BEDROC20 is below 0.25 or its optimal cardinality differs from the BEDROC-optimal cardinality.
diagnostic_gate.permitted_next_action: Design one analytically weighted, multi-threshold rank-sensitive objective without searching weights on BACE1; evaluate it by the same scaffold-holdout and strong-classical protocol.
diagnostic_gate.forbidden_next_action: Do not tune the five Stage37 weights or favorable-rank threshold to maximize these BACE1 outcomes.

interpretation_boundary: Stage42e is an outcome-informed diagnosis on BACE1 Train-266. It may identify a mechanism and authorize a single analytically defined redesign, but it cannot validate a redesigned objective, open protected data, authorize hardware, or support quantum advantage claims.
